xmldoc.short_description: Opens a file selection dialog box.

param_input_item.param_description: File filter string or cell array. Examples: '*.m', '*.nh5', or 'All Files (*)'.

param_output_item.param_description: Selected file name, or 0 when canceled.

description.p: uigetfile lets the user choose an existing file.
